## Declarations and implementations

```plato

//==
// # SDF combination trees
//
// Constructive solid geometry (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constructive_solid_geometry)
// over signed distance fields, stored as flat arrays of nodes. Leaves reference
// primitives by index into a caller-supplied primitive list; interior nodes
// combine two children by node index. The recursive evaluators live in
// `implicit-sdf.library.plato`.

// The Boolean or blending operation an SDF combination node applies.
// Union is the distance minimum, Intersection the maximum, IDifference the
// left child minus the right. Smooth variants blend over their own Radius with
// a polynomial approximation of an arc; Chamfer variants cut a 45-degree bevel
// of their own Width instead; Blend linearly interpolates the two child
// distances by Weight. The cases mirror the distance operators in
// `implicit-sdf.library.plato`, so a tree can express whatever they can.
type SdfCombine
    = Union
    | Intersection
    | Difference
    | ExclusiveOr
    | SmoothUnion(Radius: Number)
    | SmoothIntersection(Radius: Number)
    | SmoothDifference(Radius: Number)
    | ChamferUnion(Width: Number)
    | ChamferIntersection(Width: Number)
    | ChamferDifference(Width: Number)
    | Blend(Weight: Proportion);

// A zero-based index of a node within an SDF combination tree's node array.
// Nodes only reference lower-indexed nodes; -1 means "unused".
type SdfNodeIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}

// One node of a flat planar SDF tree. Leaves reference a primitive by index
// into an external primitive list; interior nodes combine two lower-indexed
// nodes. Child references are node indices, never embedded nodes.
type SdfNode2D
    implements IValue
    = Leaf(Primitive: ItemIndex)
    | Interior(Combine: SdfCombine, Left: SdfNodeIndex, Right: SdfNodeIndex);

// A flat planar SDF combination tree. Nodes may only reference lower-indexed
// nodes; Root is the index of the node producing the final distance. Leaf
// primitive indices resolve against a caller-supplied list of planar SDFs.
type SdfTree2D
    implements IValue
{
    Nodes: Array<SdfNode2D>;
    Root: SdfNodeIndex;
}

// One node of a flat spatial SDF tree. Leaves reference a primitive by index
// into an external primitive list; interior nodes combine two lower-indexed
// nodes. Child references are node indices, never embedded nodes.
type SdfNode3D
    implements IValue
    = Leaf(Primitive: ItemIndex)
    | Interior(Combine: SdfCombine, Left: SdfNodeIndex, Right: SdfNodeIndex);

// A flat spatial SDF combination tree. Nodes may only reference lower-indexed
// nodes; Root is the index of the node producing the final distance. Leaf
// primitive indices resolve against a caller-supplied list of spatial SDFs.
type SdfTree3D
    implements IValue
{
    Nodes: Array<SdfNode3D>;
    Root: SdfNodeIndex;
}
```
